app.name: Form Coach
app.privacy: Your answers stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
app.disclaimer: Form Coach gives general fitness guidance. It is not medical advice.

title.privacy: Your camera never leaves your device.

safetyNotice.title: Check with a doctor first
safetyNotice.body: Please check with a doctor before starting. You can still explore the app.

summary.title: Review your answers
summary.subtitle: Tap any answer to change it.

keys.single: Keyboard: press 1–{count} to choose · Backspace to go back
keys.multi: Keyboard: press 1–{count} to choose · Enter to continue · Backspace to go back
keys.yesno: Keyboard: press Y or N for each question · Enter to continue

safety.title: Quick safety check
safety.hint: Answer Yes or No for each one.

items.heartCondition: Has a doctor said you have a heart condition or should only do doctor-recommended exercise?
items.chestPain: Do you get chest pain, dizziness, or fainting when active?
items.boneJoint: Do you have a bone, joint, or muscle problem that exercise could make worse?
items.pregnantOrRecovering: Are you pregnant or recovering from surgery or an injury?

easyAreas.title: Any areas we should go easy on?

experience.title: How much exercise experience do you have?

activityDays.title: How many days a week are you active right now?

equipment.title: What equipment do you have?
equipment.hint: A pull-up bar unlocks pull-ups. Workouts for other equipment are coming soon.

workoutLength.title: How long do you want each workout to be?

home.title: You're all set!
home.body: Your plan is ready. Set up your phone or laptop, turn side-on to the camera, and let's go.
home.guardian: Since you're under 13, have a parent or guardian nearby when you work out.

rotate.title: Turn your phone sideways
rotate.body: Stand it on its side, about waist height, against something steady so it won't tip over.
rotate.statusPortrait: Waiting for you to turn your phone…

stepBack.title: Step back so your whole body is in view
stepBack.body: Stand about 2–3 meters (6–10 feet) away. Your head and your feet both need to be on screen.

space.title: Clear some space
space.body: Move anything you could trip over or bump into. Leave about an arm's length of room on every side.

placeLaptop.title: Set up your laptop
placeLaptop.body: Put it on a table, chair or shelf at about waist height. Tilt the screen back so the camera can see the floor where you'll stand.

camera.title: Camera check
camera.privacy: Video stays on this device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

status.stepBack: Step back so we can see your feet
status.showHead: Make sure your head is in view
status.showBody: Face the camera so we can see your body

camera.readyTitle: We can see all of you!
camera.readyBody: Camera setup is done. You're ready to work out.

errors.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
errors.noCamera: We couldn't find a camera on this device.
errors.insecure: The camera only works on a secure page. On a phone, open the https:// address from "npm run dev:phone".
errors.model: Body tracking couldn't start. Reload the page and try again.

workout.planSub: Picked for your age, level and goals. Every counted rep is checked for good form.
workout.sideOn: Most exercises are tracked side-on to the camera, so it can see your joints bend. The get-ready screen tells you how to stand.

position.shoulderRolls: Stand facing the camera with your arms relaxed.
position.catStretch: Get on your hands and knees, side-on to the camera.
position.pushups: Get into a push-up position, side-on to the camera.
position.kneePushups: Get into a push-up position on your knees, side-on to the camera.
position.wallPushups: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on the wall, side-on to the camera.
position.squats: Stand side-on to the camera, feet shoulder-width apart.
position.gluteBridges: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, side-on to the camera.
position.legRaises: Lie on your side facing the camera, legs straight. Switch sides halfway.
position.situps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, side-on to the camera.
position.lunges: Stand side-on to the camera. Step forward with one leg, then switch.
position.plank: Get into a forearm plank, side-on to the camera.
position.pullUps: Hang from the bar with straight arms, facing or side-on to the camera.

cues.stayInView: Stay where the camera can see you
cues.pullHigher: Pull your chin up to the bar
cues.rollForward: Roll your shoulders forward, slow and big
cues.catUp: Round your back up to the ceiling
cues.catDown: Now let your back sink down slowly

stopped.title: Workout stopped
stopped.body: Good call. Stop and rest now.
stopped.emergency: If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, feel faint or dizzy, or pain that doesn't go away, get help right away: call your local emergency number (911 in the US) or tell an adult nearby.
stopped.doctor: If something hurt, check with a doctor before your next workout.
